$Comment: Elsie's Apprentice: put up Christmas decorations at home, and her Reindeer Suit opens at her stall. It is
one of the two keys to her secret (Factors/SeasonsOfOrbis/Christmas_Elsie_Key.json), the one that works
on every server; a server running MMO Skill Tree also opens the suit at Building level 20. The _Christmas
folder makes the id christmas_elsie_apprentice, which the key reads once it is collected.
Npc binds it to Elsie by the id her placement keeps in both seasons (Harvest_Feast_Weaver), and the
base's Npc.TurnInId adds the report-back step to her. It opens once her part of Santa's story
(christmas_wrapping_presents) is done, and never repeats. The step is PLACE_BLOCK with the PREFIX match
the Christmas Decorator achievement uses: the game's winter pieces (WinterHoliday_), its wreath
(Winter_Holiday_Wreath) and its Christmas Packets (Furniture_Christmas_Chest_Small_). Nothing can be
placed in the Forgotten Temple, so it is done at home. Listing.MainLine false keeps it off the story's
It pays like Tomas's Apprentice (Tomas_Apprentice.json), with MMO Skill Tree's Building XP behind its
own row gate. Its words come from the keys its id spells, in christmas.mmo.lang.
Name: Elsie_Apprentice
